a.lede: Most smartphone apps need permissions to function properly, but some may have more access than they should. Thankfully, it's pretty easy to check.
a.title: Your phone's apps could have more permissions than they need – here's how to check

b.lede: Apple developers will have to declare whether their app enables dating between real people and/or AI companions, so the company can apply the proper age rating.
b.title: Apple will start mandating age requirements for dating apps
